format: JSON (STAC 1.0.0 items, one file per scene, plus catalog.json)
notes: STAC v1.0.0 Item per acquisition. Imagery is not included: each item is the scene's metadata and a detection summary. Radar items use the sar extension, optical items the eo extension (eo:cloud_cover). Platform names are fictional.
entity_catalog_note: No entity catalog. observations[].asset_id joins infrastructure_assets.json.
aoi_description: Wide-swath radar footprint. Optical scenes cover [-97.75, 27.50, -96.85, 28.15]; night radar passes cover the approaches and anchorage; very-high-resolution scenes cover about 1 to 2 km around their target.

fields.name: properties.view:sun_elevation / view:sun_azimuth
fields.notes: degrees; negative elevation means a night (radar) pass

fields.name: properties.description
fields.example: Routine wide-swath radar acquisition. Vessel detections ...
fields.notes: what the scene shows, in words

fields.name: properties.detections.vessels
fields.notes: hulls of 40 m or more detected in the scene, by area; 'uncorrelated' lists detections with no AIS match

fields.name: properties.detections.oil_on_water / flood_extent_km2 / inundation_depth_m
fields.notes: present where the scene was analysed for them

fields.name: properties.observations

example.feature: main feeder breakers B2-A, B2-B, B2-C

fields.notes: equipment states read from very-high-resolution scenes

fields.name: bbox / geometry
fields.notes: [west, south, east, north] and the same footprint as a polygon
